Acute_Scent.description: Highly developed olfactory bulb capable of parsing complex odors (e.g., Canines, Ursines).

Jacobson_Organ.description: Vomeronasal organ that 'tastes' heavy moisture-borne chemical particles in the air (e.g., Reptiles, Felines).

Pheromone_Receptors.description: Chemical receptors tuned specifically to species-level communication (e.g., Insects).

Aquatic_Chemoreception.description: Detection of dissolved particles (like blood) in water over miles (e.g., Sharks).

Carrion_Scent.description: Highly specialized detection of decaying organic matter (e.g., Vultures, Mustelids).
